# Ultimate Wiki Index and Hubs

## Core hubs
- identity / worldview hub
- system truth hub
- OpenClaw operations hub
- agent/workspace hub
- projects/workstreams hub
- chronicle/review hub
- imports/lineage hub

## Rule
Every major area needs a durable hub page that prevents important pages from becoming orphaned.

## Bootstrap recommendation
Start with a small number of strong hubs and grow outward.
